import re

def parse_expenses(content):
    expenses = []
    for line in content.strip().split('\n'):
        line = line.strip()
        if not line.startswith('- '):
            continue
        # Pattern: - Payer paid $amount for "Description". Owed equally by Name1, Name2, ...
        m = re.match(r'- (\w+) paid \$(\d+) for "([^"]+)"\. Owed equally by (.+)\.', line)
        if m:
            payer = m.group(1)
            amount = float(m.group(2))
            desc = m.group(3)
            debtors = [name.strip() for name in m.group(4).split(',')]
            expenses.append({'payer': payer, 'amount': amount, 'desc': desc, 'debtors': debtors})
    return expenses
